question: Susheela started her morning walk and noted that her shadow is at her back. After some time she turned left and then again turned right. Finally she turned right and started running. In which direction was she running? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:

Susheela started her morning walk and noted that her shadow is at her back.

After some time she turned left and then again turned right.

Finally she turned right and started running.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d730a0ca198aa9c685809f500048588567deca3d61bb88fe3e49462494287c42.png] 

So, Susheela was running in the 'South' direction.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
